title: Log in and reach the Guru dashboard
description: Verifies a teacher can log in with valid credentials and is routed to the Guru dashboard successfully.

steps.description: Verify the user lands on the Guru dashboard

title: Log in and reach the Siswa dashboard
description: Verifies a student can log in with valid credentials and is routed to the Siswa dashboard successfully.

steps.description: Verify the user lands on the Siswa dashboard

title: Require authentication when opening the Guru dashboard directly
description: Verifies an unauthenticated visitor who opens the Guru dashboard is redirected to login.

steps.description: Verify the user is redirected to the login page

title: Register a new account with role selection and reach the correct dashboard
description: Verifies a new user can register with required details, select a role, complete onboarding, and land on the role-specific dashboard.

steps.description: Fill a new email address into the email field
Fill a valid password into the password field
Verify the user lands on the dashboard that matches the selected role

title: Manage class roster, record attendance, and enter grades
description: Verifies a teacher can complete the end-to-end workflow to manage classes and students, record attendance, enter grades, and see changes reflected in the dashboard.

steps.description: Add a class and add at least one student to the roster
Enter a grade for the student
Verify the roster and gradebook reflect the saved changes

title: View enrolled classes, attendance status, and grades
description: Verifies a student can access the Siswa dashboard to view enrolled classes, see attendance status, and view grades and feedback.

steps.description: Open the attendance view for the class
Open the grades or feedback view for the class
Verify the student can see attendance status and grades/feedback for the class

title: Show empty enrolled-classes state with guidance
description: Verifies a student with no enrollments sees an empty state and guidance to join a class.

steps.description: Verify an empty enrolled-classes state is displayed with guidance to join a class

title: Show error for invalid login credentials
description: Verifies the login form rejects invalid credentials and displays an error state to the user.

steps.description: Fill invalid-user@example.com into the email field
Fill wrong-password into the password field
Verify an invalid-credentials error is displayed

title: Validate attendance or grade entry invalid input
description: Verifies the Guru dashboard prevents saving invalid attendance or grade inputs and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Open attendance or grade entry for a class
Enter an invalid value into an attendance or grade field
Verify a validation error is displayed and the invalid change is not saved

title: Block registration when required fields are missing
description: Verifies registration cannot be submitted with incomplete required details and the user is shown a validation error.

steps.description: Fill a new email address into the email field
Verify a required-fields validation error is displayed
